description: Reads two signals as the horizontal and vertical parts of a point, shears that point in both axes and rotates it about the origin, with offsets before and after and a soft limit on each output

params.text: Sets the rotation angle, -180 to 180 degrees
Attenuates and inverts the rotation CV, and at the full setting 5V there turns the pair by a further 180 degrees
Mixes -3 to 3 times the vertical input into the horizontal one before the rotation, which shears the curve sideways, despite the hover text naming it Scale
Attenuates and inverts the horizontal shearing CV, which is added to the Shearx knob
Mixes -3 to 3 times the horizontal input into the vertical one before the rotation, which shears the curve up and down
Attenuates and inverts the vertical shearing CV, which is added to the Sheary knob
Adds -10V to 10V to the first input before the shearing and the rotation
Adds -10V to 10V to the second input before the shearing and the rotation
Adds -10V to 10V to the first output after the rotation, before the saturator
Adds -10V to 10V to the second output after the rotation, before the saturator

inputs.text: Turns the pair away from the angle knob, 180 degrees for 5V at the full CV amount
Adds to the horizontal shearing, scaled by the trimpot under the Shearx knob
Adds to the vertical shearing, scaled by the trimpot under the Sheary knob
The horizontal part of the pair, and the number of channels here sets the polyphony of both outputs
The vertical part of the pair, read at the channel count of the other input

outputs.text: The horizontal part of the sheared and rotated pair, held to -10V to 10V by a parabolic saturator that softens the peaks shearing adds
The vertical part of the sheared and rotated pair, held to -10V to 10V by a parabolic saturator that softens the peaks shearing adds

notes: bypassing the module passes the first input straight to the first output and the second to the second
